findings: I2.16 defines STU as a deterministic planning fallback and says a numeric band alone records evidence rather than failing or splitting a crate.
I17.15 says I2.16 planning bands alone never create a refusal.
I18.38 says no experiment number automatically forces a split, rejects a Module, or becomes a planning default.
I18.21 supports one versioned local/CI profile and recorded tool identity.
I15.9, not I2.16, is the direct canonical basis for cargo-deny or equivalent supply-chain checks.
result.safe_residual: Deterministic STU observations may be emitted as provisional evidence; they must remain non-blocking absent a separate causal defect and qualified route profile.

accepted_findings: Independent review agrees with the W0-03 ContractChallenge.
Workspace scope and supply-chain checks are valid residual changes.
